mapper.select: select * from gc_user_access_ext where user_access_id = #{userAccessId} ORDER BY log_in_time desc limit 1

select a.* from ( select access.user_id,max(ext.id) as extid ,us.username,max(ext.log_in_time) as log_in_time,info.first_name ,info.last_name,TIMESTAMPDIFF(WEEK,max(log_in_time),NOW()) as weekNum,max(last_batchemail_time) as emailTime from gc_user_access_ext ext LEFT JOIN gc_user_access access on access.id = ext.user_access_id LEFT JOIN gc_user us on us.id = access.user_id LEFT JOIN gc_user_info info on info.id = us.info_id where ext.user_access_id is not null and ext.manager_id is null GROUP BY access.user_id ORDER BY user_id asc)a where a.log_in_time < date_sub(now(), interval #{lastDaysScope} day) and( a.emailTime < date_sub(now(), interval 14 day) or a.emailTime is null )
